scope: Train-only amplitude evidence and matched known-load validation loss experiment; no frozen source edits or GPU execution

evidence.interpretation: Every training CAD has lower TOR amplitude. Equal relative errors produce only1.3175% TOR share in the original amplitude-weighted objective, despite1/3 case sampling. At the selected checkpoint TOR still contributes only6.8689% of pointMSE. This is strong objective-weight imbalance evidence, not a causal proof that it explains all TOR fitting or geometry generalization difficulty.
evidence.gradient_limit: Objective contribution is not a measured parameter-gradient norm; network Jacobians, shared features and load response geometry can differ.

baselines_reported_by_root.interpretation: Current linear/control validation means are close; exact load linearity has not established a known-load validation advantage. Changing the objective tests a distinct amplitude-balance hypothesis.

hypothesis.name: training_case_RMS_relative_vector_MSE
hypothesis.mechanism: With case c RMS R_c and fixed common scaler s, pointMSE_c=(R_c/s)^2*relativeL2_c^2. Small-amplitude TOR cases therefore receive less objective weight per unit relative error. Multiplying only the training loss by s^2/R_c^2 makes every equally sampled case contribute its squared relative error.
hypothesis.minimal_difference: Change the case-specific training loss multiplier only; model, alpha, common decoder scale, physical metric and validation selection do not change.
hypothesis.no_guarantee: Relative weights may trade force-case absolute accuracy for low-amplitude TOR relative accuracy; evaluate known-load validation rather than assuming TOR will improve.

loss_contract.common_scale: Keep the serialized common train-only positive scale_mm and center_mm exactly0, shared by all9 basis outputs and all loads. No per-case/per-load decode or model-input normalization is introduced.
loss_contract.R_c_definition: sqrt(sum over all original training nodes/components u_mm^2 /(3*N_c))
loss_contract.fit_scope: Exactly120 train40 x ver/hor/tor cases, full labels already resident in the eventual training loader. Validation/dia/test labels never determine weights.
loss_contract.floor_policy: Root fixed1e-12mm before any held-out probe. All current R_c>=0.007150767456494562mm, so the floor is inactive. Maximum current w is59.39821958939113; no arbitrary clipping/cap or validation-selected threshold is needed.
loss_contract.normalization: Use the raw deterministic weight w_c without extra mean-weight renormalization. When the floor is inactive the full-case loss is exactly relativeL2_c^2; no adaptive/learned weights or per-update RMS estimates.
loss_contract.batch: For each of four uniformly selected distinct train cases, average squared encoded3-component error over its12800 sampled nodes, multiply by w_c, then average the four case losses. Equal sampled counts mean a nodewise repeated weight tensor with a global mean is algebraically equivalent.
loss_contract.point_mse_branch: Retain the original unweighted square().mean() operation and RNG path when point_mse is selected. Do not restructure the historical default loss for this extension.
loss_contract.decode: u_pred_mm=scale_mm*scaled_u_prediction, unchanged; the architecture still enforces linear alpha composition only for linear_basis.
loss_contract.validation: Unweighted every-original-node physical vector relativeL2; no training weight is applied to reported validation/test metrics.
loss_contract.record: Persist per-train-case R_c, N_c, w_c, exact scale/floor/formula and fit scope in config/checkpoints. Compute once, compare on resume, and never refit from new validation or held-out fields.

matched_runs.existing_point_MSE_controls: Reuse both completed10k phase1 physics runs; do not repeat them merely to add a lossflag. Preserve their frozen source commit/contracts and selected8000/7000 checkpoints.
matched_runs.paired_state: Same initial native model/encoder seed, native9-output layout and common scaler; same fixed clouds/local features, independent case_rng(seed+23) and node_rng(seed+17), sampling witness and total queried points. No architecture change or extra training step.
matched_runs.stress_policy: The same independently supervised signed scalar stress checkpoint stays frozen; no u loss reweights/updates stress, and stress is never linearly combined.
matched_runs.costs: Report wall time, selected step, training/evaluation cost and budget for every variant, including the already completed controls.

scope.dia: locked for loss fitting and model selection

known_load_selection_and_decision.primary_rule: Each new run selects minimum validation15-case mean physical displacement vector relativeL2, with the original eval schedule and earlier-step tie policy. Compare against its own physics-mode pointMSE baseline.
secondary_reporting: per-load validation mean/worst and key, including TOR
pooled physical relativeL2, RMSEmm and max-vector-error
changes in force-case physical errors when low-amplitude cases gain weight
known_load_selection_and_decision.success_interpretation: A lower known-load validation mean accompanied by improved TOR supports the loss-balance hypothesis; a training-only gain, a force/TOR tradeoff with worse overall validation, or no gain is recorded as a negative or mixed result. This does not prove a new algorithm, dia benefit, or final-test generalization.
known_load_selection_and_decision.no_weight_search: Do not choose floor/caps/mixing weights, steps or architecture from validation/dia sweeps. The declared full relative-case objective is the one matched change. If any later variant is needed it receives a separately stated hypothesis and fresh cost record.
known_load_selection_and_decision.frozen_probe_boundary: The already frozen original model dia/oracle probe is a separate diagnostic. It does not determine this plan or its weights; do not revise the loss recipe from its results. Any later dia evaluation of new models needs a newly frozen selection manifest and cannot be used to choose those models.

implementation_gate.root_action_required: Original code/results are now committed locally. Root next permits the patch only after the frozen original-DIA probe has finished; no source is modified while that evaluator can depend on the original trainer.
implementation_gate.future_contract_changes: Add u_loss plus serialized train-only weights/floor/formula and the new source revision to strict scope/checkpoints. Keep historical frozen sources and outputs intact, use new output directories and a separate ready gate.
required_minimal_checks: Synthetic equal relative vector error gives equal weighted loss despite different amplitudes
Only training cases determine weights; decoder remains common scalar/zero center
implementation_gate.GPU_dispatch: Root serial coordinator only, after the new implementation ready gate; this design does not launch jobs.
implementation_gate.old_ready_file_policy: Keep notes/physics_trainer_ready.json as the original phase receipt; never replace it with the relative-loss phase hashes.

future_interface.scope: Existing _scope(args) five-tuple stays metadata-only; append requested.u_loss and loss-contract schema/floor/fit scope, never load targets here.
future_interface.config: config.u_loss stores name, exact formula, common scaler reference, RMS_floor_mm=1e-12, fit_case_keys, and train-only case_records{RMS_mm,nodes,weight}; originalpointmode records unweighted loss without weight fitting.
future_interface.training_setup: After permitted training labels are already loaded, compute full-case float64 RMS once per train case. Build immutable train-case weights on GPU; do not build validation weights or calculate minibatch RMS.
future_interface.loss: point_mse retains (prediction-target).square().mean() unchanged. relative_case_mse reshapes the equal-sized batch into[C,N_per_case,3], computes one mean encoded squared error per case and applies fixed GPU weights before a case mean.
future_interface.resume: Compare config.u_loss/strict contract/serialized fixed weights and common scaler, restore Adam and both independent sampler streams; no LR override or weight rescaling on resume.
future_interface.selection: Same unweighted validation15-case mean physicalvector relativeL2; no change to decoder, branch alpha, signed stress reference or any dia selection rule.
future_interface.ready: Only after necessary CPU equal-relative-error/defaultloss/fixed-scaler checks write notes/physics_relative_loss_ready.json with newphysics_train sourceSHA; then freeze source and let root singlequeue dispatch.
